trends.summary: Instagram's algorithm continues to prioritize high completion rates and immediate retention, making payoff-first hooks and concise edits essential for gaming content. Utilizing trending native audio and seamless loop mechanics is driving outsized reach for short-form clips.
new_ideas: Side-by-side player cam reactions synchronized with in-game physics glitches.
In-game cinematic director-mode cinematic edits with seamless transition beats.
algorithm: Instagram's recent ranking adjustments heavily reward original audio usage and content that achieves high watch-time completion percentages within the first 3 seconds.
